clue.text: Not much change being in the force

definitions.meaning: small bronze-coloured coins, pennies and twopences, are loose change of little value
a police officer, someone serving in the police force, in informal speech

explanation.definitionFit: Coppers are low-value coins and also slang for police officers, so both senses fit.

clue.text: It's not cheap playing where there's nobody there

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters frolic about and land in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles that a pricey sport or game is costly to take part in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' rearranges NOTCHEAP; 'It's' is a link. The definition is cryptic: the memorial honours the dead whose bodies lie elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A monument is literally an empty tomb, commemorating people buried somewhere else, so nobody lies there.

clue.text: Of family members: they don't exist when a mate's around

indicators.note: around says the word for a mate encloses the other piece

parts.note: a mate or friend is a pal
they don't exist means they aren't, contracted and written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: A mysterious remark that one's relatives vanish when one's friend appears.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes what relates to mothers and fathers, the closest family members.

clue.text: Abolish the Times entirely to start with

parts.note: times or ages are eras

indicators.note: to start with picks only the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A call to shut down the Times newspaper completely, starting now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the Times' looks like the newspaper but means periods of history.
explanation.definitionFit: To abolish something is to wipe it out, delete it from existence.

clue.text: Fastening for rope is squeezing top of man's beard

indicators.note: squeezing says the rope fastening holds a letter pressed inside it

parts.note: a cleat is the fitting on a boat or wall a rope is tied round

indicators.note: top of picks the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A sailor's rope fitting is said to be gripping the end of a man's whiskers.
explanation.walkthrough: The climber's common name is old man's beard; Araucaria lets 'man's' serve the definition and also give its top letter, a deliberate double use.
explanation.definitionFit: Old man's beard is the common name of wild clematis, from its fluffy grey seed heads.

clue.text: 15 keeping Anglicans together over Thames?

parts.note: the archbishop of 15 lives at a London palace and holds the Anglican communion together, bridging its factions; the river crossing is named after that palace's borough

explanation.walkthrough: 15 is WILLIAMS: Rowan Williams, then Archbishop of Canterbury, whose London home is Lambeth Palace on the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: This London river crossing sits beside the archbishop's palace, so it is his bridge in a playful sense.

clue.text: See 12
Island, otherwise ait, lacking colour

indicators.note: otherwise says the little word is to be put another way, its letters reordered

parts.note: something lacking colour is pale or wan

explanation.surface: Describing a river islet as dull and colourless.
explanation.walkthrough: An ait (or eyot) is a small island in a river, especially the Thames; 'otherwise' turns AIT into TAI.
explanation.definitionFit: The country is a large island off the coast of China.

clue.text: This is a distinguishing feature of a hurtful type

indicators.note: feature of says the answer is a part contained within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A sentence pointing out the defining trait of a cruel personality.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes pleasure in causing pain is the very picture of a hurtful person.

clue.text: Opera in London or Manchester

indicators.note: in says the answer is contained within the following words

explanation.surface: An opera being staged in one of two English cities.
explanation.definitionFit: Bellini's opera about a Druid priestess is a famous bel canto work.

clue.text: Maid known about with others

indicators.note: about suggests the letters are turned around and mixed up

explanation.surface: A housemaid recognised in company with other people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges MAIDKNOWN. The definition leans on the maid: a maid together with others makes up all women.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means women collectively, which a maid with all the others forms.

clue.text: We help retired physician probing smell that adjoins Thames

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: probing says the doctor and his help push into the middle of the smell

parts.note: a bad smell is a stink

indicators.note: retired means the word for help goes back, read in reverse

parts.note: help is aid
a physician is a doc

explanation.surface: We assist a retired doctor investigating a foul odour by the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns the word for help backwards, and 'probing' splits the smell before its final letter. The dock is in London's Docklands, on the Isle of Dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: These London docks lie on the Isle of Dogs right beside the river, so they adjoin it.

clue.text: State primate responsible for the …

parts.note: a US state in the south
a primate is an archbishop; Rowan Williams was Primate of All England when this appeared

explanation.surface: A US state's top churchman takes responsibility for something, the sentence running on into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primate' looks like an ape but means a senior archbishop. The ellipsis carries on into 12 across, the play the dramatist wrote.
explanation.definitionFit: The American playwright wrote the play named in the next clue, so he is responsible for it.

clue.text: … good girl meeting guys at Silver Lake

definitions.note: the ellipsis takes up the end of 11 across: the work that playwright was responsible for

parts.note: a girl is a lass
guys are men
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America

explanation.surface: A nice young woman meets some blokes at a lake called Silver Lake.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is borrowed from 11 across through the ellipsis: what Tennessee Williams wrote. 'at' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The memory play of 1944 about Laura and her animal figurines is Williams's breakthrough work.

clue.text: Opera has 20 with low frequency separated among the lost

indicators.note: separated says the other piece goes in apart from those letters, at a different spot
among says the frequency letters go inside the word for the lost

parts.note: perishers are those who perish, the lost
LF is the standard abbreviation for low frequency in radio
20 across is ADULT, and A was the old British film certificate for adult viewing

explanation.surface: An opera combines porn with a low radio band among people lost to the world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'separated' says the two inserted pieces go in at different spots, not side by side. 'has' and 'with' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Bizet's opera about two pearl divers in Ceylon is best known for its tenor-baritone duet.

clue.text: Less convincing about turning into celebrity manager?

indicators.note: about says the weaker word wraps round the other piece

parts.note: a lame excuse is unconvincing, so a less convincing one is lamer

indicators.note: turning says the little word next to it is twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A weaker argument changes into a show-business agent?
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' rearranges the little word and 'about' wraps the weaker word round it. The definition is cryptic: a lion is a celebrity, and a tamer manages one.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrity is a social lion, and the circus performer manages, or tames, lions.

clue.text: See 11
Humpty Dumpty's terrible experience in China

parts.note: Humpty Dumpty, of the nursery rhyme, is an egg, so his is an egg's
a terrible experience is hell

explanation.surface: Humpty Dumpty's fall described as a horrible ordeal in the Far East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country but is fine porcelain; the possessive gives EGG'S, its apostrophe dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggshell china is very thin, delicate porcelain, named for its fragility.

clue.text: Courtesy of the successful stud farmer?

definitions.meaning: politeness and refined manners, as from a good upbringing
a horse breeder who produces winners does his breeding well

explanation.definitionFit: Refined manners are called this, and a skilled stud owner literally practises breeding that is good.

clue.text: Means of saving solution in memory

indicators.note: in says the solution sits inside the memory

parts.note: ROM is read-only memory in a computer
ANS is the abbreviation for answer, a solution

explanation.surface: A way of storing data in computer memory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'saving' looks like computer storage but means rescuing a hostage.
explanation.definitionFit: A ransom is the payment made to free, or save, a captive.

clue.text: Bribe to make one bonny and blithe, and good and gay

parts.words: bonny and blithe, and good and gay
parts.note: in the rhyme Monday's Child, the child born on the Sabbath day is bonny and blithe and good and gay; Su is short for Sunday
to make one so, the child must be born that day

explanation.surface: Buying someone a cheerful, happy and virtuous nature with a bribe.
explanation.walkthrough: The rhyme ends 'the child that is born on the Sabbath day is bonny and blithe, and good and gay', so Sunday-born gives SU plus BORN.
explanation.definitionFit: To suborn someone is to bribe or induce them into wrongdoing, such as perjury.

clue.text: Was last month's poster pornographic?

parts.note: a poster is an advertisement, an ad
ult., short for ultimo, means of last month in old business letters

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the advertisement from last month was obscene.
explanation.definitionFit: Adult films and magazines are sexually explicit, so the word stands for pornographic.

clue.text: 14 of a sort with closer resolution

parts.note: with means and, joining

indicators.note: resolution is the working out or rearranging of the letters of the word before it

explanation.surface: A neater resolution achieved with something closer.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 is LION TAMER. In the fable, the slave pulled a thorn from a lion's paw, and the lion spared him in the arena.
explanation.definitionFit: The runaway slave of legend befriended and calmed a lion, so he was a kind of lion tamer.

clue.text: Paint, tedious work led by the heart

indicators.note: the heart is the middle letter of the tedious word, which moves to lead it

parts.note: a chore is a dull task

explanation.surface: Decorating is a dull job, though done with feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: The central letter O of CHORE moves to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Ochre is an earthy yellow-brown pigment used in paints.

clue.text: Navigational warning by compere performing in shop

indicators.note: in says the compere and the performing go inside the shop

parts.note: a shop is a store
MC is master of ceremonies, a compere
on stage is on, performing

explanation.surface: A host doing a turn in a store gives a warning to sailors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link. A storm cone is a black canvas cone hoisted at British coastguard stations to warn of gales.
explanation.definitionFit: The cone hoisted at coastal stations warned shipping of gales, a signal to navigators.

clue.text: Pullman — greeting!

parts.note: he is the male pronoun, a man
ave is the Latin word of greeting, hail

explanation.surface: A hello to a luxurious railway carriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pullman' must be split into Pull and man; a Pullman is a luxury railway carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: To heave is to haul or pull with great effort.

clue.text: Poisonous plant to go with 10 across and duck?

parts.note: 10 across contains WOMAN, and man goes with woman
a drake is a male duck

explanation.surface: A deadly herb to accompany womankind and a waterbird.
explanation.definitionFit: The mandrake is a narcotic plant of the nightshade family, poisonous in quantity.

clue.text: Craft holder (Roman numerals to be included)

indicators.note: included says the Latin verb goes inside the pair of numerals

parts.note: V and L are Roman numerals for five and fifty
esse is Latin for to be, apt beside Roman

explanation.surface: A box for craft supplies, with Roman numbering added.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is two senses together: a vessel is a craft, a boat, and also a holder, a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel is both a ship or boat and a container for liquids.
